body.x: Wiemann bedroom furniture(http://www.wiemann-online.com) is manufactured to the highest standards in its highly mechanised, very efficient factory, which is accredited to the international quality management assurance standard ISO 9001: 2000. Products are also approved under the German BQ quality mark scheme.

The specifications are surprisingly high in relation to the price. Panels are wrapped in top quality printed foils using the latest printing technologies available, so all our wood finishes look and even feel incredibly realistic.
Wiemann make over 150 ranges of bedroom furniture for markets all over Europe. They all have a distinctive European style.

Wiemann's wardrobe systems are free-standing (which means you can take them with you when you move, if you want to!) but with cupboard and shelving unit widths ranging from as little as 50cm up to 400cm, you can fill every nook and cranny and create an amazing amount of storage space - especially if you choose one of our popular overbed ranges!

All wardrobes come fitted with two sturdy shelves with rounded edges and a hanging rail as standard. But there are many other accessory options to choose from - just have a look at our accessories page for a flavour!
Wardrobes and beds are, for practical reasons flat pack but all chests, except the 'extra large chests', are pre-assembled.
They're just showing you a flavour of some of the options available here - for full details, to see other finishes and to plan for new bedroom to perfection.
Wiemann will boast there high quality bedroom furniture at CES 2012 held in Cologne, Germany, from Jan 16-22, 2012.
